<b>{{PAGENAME}}</b> is a refined crafting material that is used to make the highest tier of stone-work. It's one of the few items that require [[faith]] in order to craft, making them relatively precious. They can be crafted at a [[stone cutter II]] or bought from the vendor [[Cory]].
